newsitem.title: USA: Fastest income growth in Nev., Ariz., Ga., Wash..
newsitem.headline: Fastest income growth in Nev., Ariz., Ga., Wash..

text.p: The fastest growth in personal income took place in Nevada, Arizona, Georgia and Washington state in the third quarter of 1996, according to estimates released Tuesday by the Commerce Department.
Personal income rose 2.3 percent in Nevada, 2 percent in Arizona, and 1.9 percent in Georgia and Washington, well above the national average of 1.4 percent.
The report cited a variety of reasons for the fast growth in incomes including above average increases in earnings in construction, government and manufacturing.
The slowest income growth came in Alaska, Hawaii, West Virginia, Indiana, Michigan, Missouri and Montana, the report said. They all had income growth 0.5 percentage point below the national average.
